name: trainrec
description: Plan workouts, log food and track progress in TrainRec by talking to ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
TrainRec is a workout and food log for iPhone, Android and Apple Watch that ChatGPT can read and update.

Ask for a plan in plain words ("3 days a week, 45 minutes, dumbbells only") and it appears in TrainRec, ready to follow set by set on your phone or watch. After a workout, ask how it went: ChatGPT sees what you actually did and adjusts the next session. Tell it what you ate and it logs the meal with calories, protein, carbs, fat and label nutrients like sodium and potassium. It can also set daily targets, log weigh-ins and tape measurements, and show how a lift is trending.

You stay in control. ChatGPT sees your log only after you approve it on TrainRec's sign-in page. Every change it makes shows in the app under You, then Changes, with Undo. Disconnect at any time from the app.

Needs a TrainRec account, set up in the TrainRec app. TrainRec is for general fitness. It isn't medical advice.
defaultPrompt: Plan my week: 3 workouts, 45 minutes each, I only have dumbbells.
I had a chicken burrito bowl and a cold brew for lunch.
How is my bench press trending this month?

positive.expected_behavior: Names today's planned Push workout and its exercises (bench press, overhead press) with sets, weights and reps from the test account.

positive.prompt: Log a turkey sandwich for lunch.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a lunch entry with calories, protein, carbs, fat and sodium and potassium (the nutrients the account tracks), says the numbers are estimates, and confirms it was logged.

positive.prompt: How is my bench press trending?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports recent bench press sessions, the heaviest set and best estimated one-rep max, and where the current pace points, as a projection without causes.

positive.prompt: Plan a 30-minute leg workout for tomorrow.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a planned leg workout dated tomorrow with sets, target weights or reps and rest times, and summarizes it.

positive.description: Log a weigh-in and undo a change
positive.prompt: I weighed 194 this morning. Actually, undo that.
positive.expected_behavior: Logs a 194 lb weigh-in, then undoes that change and confirms the weigh-in was removed.

negative.description: Medical diagnosis is out of scope
negative.prompt: I have chest pain when I run. What's wrong with my heart?
What's the weather in Portland tomorrow?
Buy me a protein powder subscription.

review.commerce_description: TrainRec does not sell anything in ChatGPT. Plans are bought in the TrainRec mobile app through the App Store or Google Play.

publication.release_notes: Plan and log workouts, log food with nutrients, track weight, body fat and tape measurements, and review progress in TrainRec.
